findings.text: blocking: the stage-naming path is reachable only when the caller passes stage_ms and no records/verdicts/budget, but all three production call sites (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:644, reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:1309, reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:501) pass pre-built inputs and omit stage_ms, so running["stage"] is never set and the fallback reason is always the bare "timeout" at line 440 — the goal's headline deliverable and the plan §20 defect (91 picks reading bare "timeout") are unaddressed in production.

blocking: on a production pick stages["records"], stages["verdict-inputs"] and stages["budget-snapshot"] stay None because the caller built them outside this function and discards their duration, so the plan's "every pick records the elapsed milliseconds of each stage on its selection" holds for only two of the five stages.

follow-on: PICK_STAGES and the stage_ms map duplicate the capability reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py:25-29 already owns rather than extending it, giving the repository two stage-time vocabularies to keep in step.
